[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/compare/v1.14.50...v1.14.51)

#### What's Changed

- fix: Exec returns wrong arg count in "not enough args" error by [@​semihbkgr](https://redirect.github.com/semihbkgr) in [#​1396](https://redirect.github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1396)
- refactor: Clean up deprecated // +build legacy build tags by [@​zxysilent](https://redirect.github.com/zxysilent) in [#​1428](https://redirect.github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1428)
- Fixed som typos and wrappings in sqlite3\_func\_crypt.go documentation. by [@​kberov](https://redirect.github.com/kberov) in [#​1367](https://redirect.github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1367)
- Replace copy-on-write handle map with sync.Map by [@​mattn](https://redirect.github.com/mattn) in [#​1453](https://redirect.github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1453)
- Avoid per-row goroutines for query cancellation by [@​bradengroom](https://redirect.github.com/bradengroom) in [#​1444](https://redirect.github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1444)
- Flush statement cache when the schema changes by [@​mattn](https://redirect.github.com/mattn) in [#​1452](https://redirect.github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3/pull/1452)
